rules.matchersWeakenedNote: No matcher was replaced by a weaker one on the same read (no toHaveTextContent→toBeInTheDocument, no exact→regex, no queryBy for getBy, no removed `not`). Reads dropped or relaxed are listed in readsDroppedOrRelaxed, each with its reason; the compiler-API comparison is in selfCheck.

forTask115: Every logging dialog's title moved 4 px up (trimmed to its capitals) so the X's frame starts on the letters' top (C41, R105).
Long logs now scroll to the frame's inner lower border and are cut on the inner chamfer mid-scroll; no scrollbar shows (C57, C59; P01, P03). At rest the form keeps Round 7's 16 px inset.
A timed log's complete movement groups (AMRAP, For Time, ladder; EMOM with two loaded movements) sit 36 px apart (was 24), as a superset round's do (C05).
The dialog follows an on-screen keyboard (visual viewport); checked with an emulated viewport change only — try it on a real phone (iOS Safari especially).
Round 7's anchor set log fits a 320 × 568 phone; Round 7's twelve-round ladder log with no rounds marked fits 390 × 844 (both content-height, no scroll).
Round 7's Review standard rows have no separator; the J017 peer check reads one gap there (TASK-112's C04 item).
Round 7's gallery coverage register quotes C47's criterion wording, which names the removed helper sentence (the gallery's requirement list, not the form).
Ladder: no Log results while it runs (owner decision 2026-11-16); the movement note keeps its fixed one-line title (owner decision 4).

galleryChanges.change: title 4 px higher (top trimmed to capitals); X unchanged
galleryChanges.measured: task-041 base run: title visible top 4 px below the X frame's (e.g. 223.5 vs 219.5 at 390); after: equal (task-041 passes; parity title.top = x.top = 16 in every receipt)

galleryChanges.change: scroller seated on the ring's inner edge (was 12 px inside); content cut at the inner border and chamfer while scrolling; frame size and form position at rest unchanged
galleryChanges.measured: parity receipts: scroller bottom 2 px (= border) from the frame's outer bottom on both sides

amrap, for_time, ladder (and any timed log with two movement groups)

galleryChanges.change: no automatic outline or frame focus ring (not visible in pointer-opened gallery captures)

rules.galleryChangesLimit: Base-versus-tree gallery images were not captured side by side (no base capture run); the differences above are measured from the base task-041 run, the CSS change and the parity receipts.
